text:
maria: FYI team — planning the SDK v25 client adapter rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quick sync: who’s owning deploy, smoke, rollback readiness, and client comms?

tj: I can own the deploy window and smoke orchestration. Planning a 09:00 -> 09:30 phased lift across regions.

sam: I’ll take rollback runbook and postmortem hooks. I’ll also prepare the feature-flag toggle.

joyce: I’ll do client comms + release notes. Short note to customers with migration steps and known compat footnotes.

alan: Heads-up — telemetry owners: I’ll validate SDK telemetry keys after deploy (quick check: `POST /v1/telemetry/verify`).

maria: thanks. tj — can you paste the smoke commands and the quick health criteria? keep it minimal.

tj: sure — smoke procedure (short):
```
# region smoke (10m max)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO" -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-4.0","input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
# check 200, latency < 300ms p50, no OOM logs
```
pass = 3 successful regions within 20m, no error spike in infra-errors counter.

sam: Rollback checklist (short):
- flip feature flag `sdk_v25_disable`
- revert proxy routing rule to `sdk_v24`
- restart pool for affected backend (graceful)
- run `verify-smoke.sh --expected v24`
if anything goes wrong, page eng-oncall and start rollback.

joyce: Client comms draft: short email + changelog snippet: breaking: header header changes for advanced streaming; fallback: SDKs auto-detect, but recommend upgrade. Will post in #product and send docs link.

maria: timeline recap: 08:30 — final preflight (owners onsite), 08:45 — freeze, 09:00 — phased lift region1, 09:15 — region2, 09:30 — region3, 10:00 — full roll verification. Sound good?

tj: I’ll open the canary bucket and tag smoke owners. I’ll also add traces and a short runbook in the deploy ticket.

alan: I’ll queue the telemetry checks and add alert if 4xx/5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m.

sam: I’ve uploaded `rollback-playbook.md` to the ticket and linked runbook snippets.

joyce: Posting the customer note now; will tag `@customers` and include migration snippet and simple troubleshooting steps.

maria: one last ask — QA: please run the ephemeral integration harness against the canary images (tests: auth, streaming handshake, token expiry). Quick commands: `./integration/run --canary`

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by tj at 1758883200 (09:00 PT). CI green.

maria: perfect. if anything slips, call the rollback within the first 30m. I’ll be on standby in this thread and on call. :thumbsup:

tj: copy. I’ll ping here at each milestone and post results. :rocket:
